Method of Attack: Masquerades as official tax management app to steal personal information and banking credentials
Banking trojan features targeting financial institutes via phishing pages
Records screen and captures key presses
Loads real income tax site via WebView and steals credentials by recording screen and keylogging
Checks URLs for successful login to validate exfiltrated data
Displays fake refund dialogue to lure victims to phishing page
Phishing page clones real tax portal to steal financial information
Monitors Accessibility Service for targeted banking apps
Collects keylogging data and sends to C2 server
Abuses CallScreeningService to block incoming calls during attack
Impacted Systems: Customers of 18 Indian banks including SBI
Attack Vector: APK installation masquerading as official Income Tax Department app
Requesting SMS, call log, external storage permissions
Phishing pages and cloned tax portal
Monitoring targeted banking apps via Accessibility Service
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing pages mimicking Indian Income Tax Department site
Fake refund dialogue box offering Rs 57,100 ($700)
Keywords activating loggers related to targeted banks
Use of CallScreeningService to block calls
